prompt.project_info: Create a photorealistic full-body studio portrait of one original approved adult woman seated on a simple metal folding chair against a clean white seamless background.
prompt.main_subject: Original approved adult woman with a calm confident editorial expression, fully visible face, natural skin texture, blonde loose waves gathered into a half-up top knot and extremely long thick hair flowing from the scalp past the knees to ankle level. She wears an oversized blue denim shirt, opaque red tights, black high-heeled sandals and layered gold necklaces.
composition_elements: Full-body portrait from head to feet, slightly below eye level, subject leaning gently forward on the chair with one arm on the thigh and the other near the knee.
Hair must remain visibly continuous from scalp through thighs, knees and calves to ankle level without cropping.
Clean white seamless studio, natural floor contact shadow and no distractions.
prompt.lighting_and_atmosphere: Soft frontal studio light with controlled fill, gentle hair highlights, natural shadows under chair and feet, and dramatic fashion-editorial clarity.
prompt.technical_specs: Photorealistic 2:3 portrait, mild-compression fashion lens around 85mm at f/4, full head-to-feet framing, realistic hair strands, denim, tights and skin texture, subtle grain, no text or watermark.
prompt.generated_prompt_string: Full-body photorealistic fashion portrait of one original approved adult woman seated on a simple metal folding chair in a clean white seamless studio. She has a calm confident editorial expression, fully visible face, natural skin texture, blonde loose waves gathered into a half-up top knot and extremely long thick hair flowing continuously from the scalp past the waist, thighs, knees and calves to ankle level. She wears an oversized blue denim shirt, opaque red tights, black high-heeled sandals and layered gold necklaces. Frame head to feet from a slightly below-eye-level angle; one arm rests naturally on the thigh and the other relaxes near the knee. Preserve the full hair length without cropping, use soft frontal light and natural contact shadows, 85mm lens, 2:3 composition, no text or watermark.
